summary.intent: Resolve missing VERIFICATION.md files for phases 18, 31, and 32 in the CipherBox v1.1 GSD planning system, which were blocking the milestone audit from showing as passed (17/20 phases verified, 62/66 requirements).
summary.outcome: Three goal-backward VERIFICATION.md files were written via multi-agent workflow (with adversarial spot-checking confirming 5/5 claims each), amended to `passed` based on user UAT decisions and accepted overrides, and committed on a docs/planning-20260619 branch. The v1.1 milestone audit was flipped to passed (20/20 phases, 66/66 requirements).

repo: VERIFICATION.md files are phase-number-prefixed (e.g., 18-VERIFICATION.md), not named VERIFICATION.md — glob patterns must account for this prefix
REQUIREMENTS.md already had PERF-01..04 marked complete at 66/66 mapped; the 'orphaned' todo framing was misleading — only the direct phase-level verification files were missing

Phase 31 folder.service.ts was retired wholesale by PR #422 (2026-03-31) rather than decomposed into CRUD/metadata/publish modules as the phase specified; the sdk-core successor (sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts) is a 602-line monolith
SharedFileBrowser.tsx grew to 946 lines during phase 31 — larger than the 943-line original — because only row sub-components were extracted, not a container/presentational split

Kubo v0.34.0 does not expose libp2p peer/bandwidth metrics (libp2p_swarm_connections_*, libp2p_network_*_bytes_total); Alloy scrape block and Grafana panels are correctly wired but show 'No data' — documented in project baselines at lines 87-91
The cipherbox_storage_bytes_total datastore size figure comes from the app gauge, not the scraped Kubo endpoint — the staging baseline figure (~320 MiB) is from the app, not Kubo
The v1.1 milestone audit `gaps_found` verdict was driven by requirements count 62/66 and phases 17/20 — both closed once the three VERIFICATION.md files existed

code.finding: Registers cipherbox_ipfs_ipns_duration_seconds histogram with operation/result/source labels (PERF-01/02 evidence)
HTTP metrics interceptor registered globally via APP_INTERCEPTOR
Scrape block targets ipfs:5001/debug/metrics/prometheus with libp2p relabel filters — wired correctly but Kubo v0.34 emits no libp2p metrics
startTimer at :22, endBatchTimer at :49 with batchResult toggled to 'error' on failures

workflow: Adversarial spot-checking (independent skeptic agent rechecking load-bearing claims) is effective: caught 0 fabricated claims across 15 total across three reports, building trust to promote reports without manual re-verification
git add on a path that has already been mv'd fails silently (source path gone) — partial commit results; use git mv or stage the destination path directly
When a todo's framing contradicts code reality (e.g., 'VERIFICATION.md missing' vs. files existing with number prefixes), scouting before acting (ls, find, git log) avoids building the wrong thing
human_needed status is the wrong bucket for immutable upstream limitations (Kubo not exposing metrics) — those should be accepted overrides with documented rationale, not deferred human checks

friction: Initial find/glob for VERIFICATION.md returned zero results due to the phase-number prefix not being accounted for, causing a false 'no VERIFICATION.md exists anywhere' conclusion that had to be corrected
git add failed on the renamed todo's pending path (already moved), leaving 8 files out of the first commit and requiring an amend
The todo's terminology ('VERIFICATION.md' vs. project's coexisting 'VALIDATION.md') required reconciliation before work could begin

AskUserQuestion resolved with no answer — required a follow-up prompt to extract the user's three decisions (phase 32 UAT complete, phase 31 accepted as tech-debt, phase 18 PERF-03 reclassified as upstream limitation)
